name: Zettelkasten Archive Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Import the same archive into the same folder again, and it skips the notes that already exist.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Zettelkasten Archive Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
